sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Mature woman with shoulder-length light brown/caramel curls rolled outward on both sides beneath a brown fedora with a narrow golden tan hatband. Fine brown arched eyebrows, serious composed slightly pursed closed lips, head turned slightly toward screen left with eyes near viewer. Brown/taupe tailored open-lapel jacket and a warm ocher-orange scarf tied tightly at the neck, with one large loose scarf end flowing across the chest toward screen right. Preserve the actual hairstyle and hat tilt, original scarf/knot, close bust crop, left-side illumination and complete charcoal-to-gray painted rectangular background. Fine scarf weave and tiny hair strands cannot be resolved exactly; no eyeglasses.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Woman with short voluminous dark brown tightly rolled curls and gold-rim aviator sunglasses with dark gray lenses. Large round gold earrings with warm pink/orange centers hang on both sides. Calm poised expression with slightly parted reddish lips, head angled a little toward screen right while facing near viewer. Olive/mustard garment has broad bright golden-yellow crossed V-shaped edging/lapels over the chest. Preserve the rounded curl silhouette, sunglasses and both earrings, actual clothing neckline, bust crop, left lighting and full dark charcoal/gray painted background. Sunglasses obscure eyes and most brows; do not invent detailed eye placement through opaque lenses. Tiny earring texture and lens reflections are unresolved.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Young woman with bright copper/auburn shoulder-length curled bob, curled outward at both cheeks, brown arched brows and green eyes. Gray-purple fedora with narrow ocher-gold band sits atop the curls. Slightly turned head toward screen left and soft confident expression with subtly parted reddish lips. Purple tailored high-button blouse/jacket with a pointed lavender collar, narrow blue piping along collar and central placket and visible dark blue round buttons. Preserve the hat tilt, full curl volume, actual pointed closed collar, cropped bust, soft left lighting and full charcoal-to-gray painted rectangle. No glasses. Button embossing and individual hair strands are not readable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman with center-parted brown hair visible only across the front of a gray-lilac headscarf, large round pale gold-rim spectacles and a restrained warm smile, looking slightly toward screen right. Scarf wraps over the head and around the neck, with a dark burgundy patterned lower band and tied/folded floral fabric near the throat. Taupe/brown buttoned coat has broad pale gray/white pointed lapels, visible gray buttons and a gray garment beneath. Preserve eyeglasses, gray/burgundy scarf coverage and knot, actual coat opening, mature calm expression, cropped shoulders, left-side light and complete dark gray rectangular backing. Tiny floral pattern, spectacles reflections and tooth/lip microdetails are too small to assert precisely; no hat besides scarf.
